name: D→A:WHITE
source:
Taking place two months after the events of D→A:BLACK, the player once again takes control of [url=/c74351]Shinjou Touya[/url], a "Shinigami" who works together with the angel [url=/c74352]Yuriel Arlencloyn[/url] to guide lost souls called "Creeps" that are lingering in the human realm.

[Edited from MobyGames]
translation:
故事发生在D→A:BLACK事件两个月后。玩家再次操控[url=/c74351]新城灯夜[/url]，一名与天使[url=/c74352]尤里尔·阿伦克莱恩[/url]合作的「死神」，引导滞留人界、被称为「Creeps」的迷失灵魂。

[改编自MobyGames]
